entities.summary: Jacob Daniel Wiley is an American-born naturalized Macedonian professional basketball player for the Cangrejeros de Santurce of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN). He played college basketball for Montana, Lewis–Clark, and Eastern Washington.
